page: Amazon Web Services g6.4xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The host is equipped with an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor operating at 3.4 GHz, providing 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory consists of 64 GB of DDR4 RAM running at 3 GHz, maintaining a balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. Local ephemeral storage is provided by a 600 GB NVMe SSD, and networking is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA L4 GPU from the Ada Lovelace generation, featuring 22 GB of video RAM. In performance benchmarks, the instance demonstrates top-tier capability in machine learning inference tasks. For small language models (135M), it achieves 12,171.9 prompt processing tokens per second and 467.72 text generation tokens per second. For medium-sized models (7B), prompt processing reaches 2,268.22 tokens per second with generation at 53.89 tokens per second, both scoring in the top 10 percent of evaluated instances. Processing prompts for 70B models places within the top 25 percent at 35.92 tokens per second.

General-purpose computing metrics position the host in the middle tier. Geekbench multi-core registers at 10,077 and PassMark CPU score reaches 23,622.65, accompanied by strong single-core stress-ng performance ranking in the top quartile. However, uncached memory bandwidth reveals a hardware constraint, falling into the bottom quartile at 39.33 GB/sec for large block reads and 22.81 GB/sec for writes. Redis throughput measures 18.09 million operations per second, while static web serving delivers 18.34 GB/sec.

Given the integration of a power-efficient NVIDIA L4 GPU and balanced system resources, the instance delivers high compute and inference density relative to full-scale training servers. The server is suited for real-time natural language inference, audio and video processing pipelines, AI-assisted graphic rendering, and GPU-accelerated application serving requiring dedicated local NVMe scratch storage.
description: Amazon Web Services g6.4xlarge is an accelerated computing instance featuring an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor running at 3.4 GHz with 16 vCPUs (8 physical cores) and 64 GB of DDR4 memory. It integrates a dedicated NVIDIA L4 Ada Lovelace GPU with 22 GB of VRAM, 600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, and a baseline network throughput of 10 Gbps. Benchmark evaluations indicate top-tier performance for small and medium large language model inference, delivering 2,268.22 prompt processing tokens per second on 7B models. Central compute tests reflect solid single-core stress-ng throughput alongside moderate multi-core and general computational benchmark figures. The instance experiences lower uncached memory bandwidth relative to specialized memory-dense configurations. With balanced core memory ratios and dedicated acceleration, this server is configured for generative AI inference, media processing pipelines, and graphical workloads requiring dedicated accelerator capacity.
